comportamentos: Guard the professor-scoped update/destroy rules for Grant, Paper, PaperProfessor and PaperStudent with `if user.professor.present?`: present

Keep `can :destroy, PaperProfessor/PaperStudent, paper: { owner: nil }` inside the guard, so the remove link still works for authorship rows of an unsaved paper in the subform: missing (the candidate deletes both rules, which brings back the access-denied notice the official fix explicitly avoids)

Skip the assertion rules when the user has the aluno role but no student (`roles[ROLE_ALUNO] && user.student.present?`), avoiding the NoMethodError: partially present (generate_assertion no longer raises, but `can :assertion_pdf, Assertion` is still granted to an aluno with no student, unlike the official fix)
justificativa: The candidate adds the professor guard, but it removes the `owner: nil` destroy rules that the official fix keeps on purpose for unsaved papers, and it still grants `assertion_pdf` when `user.student` is nil, so its observable behavior differs from the official fix.
